content:
This week we're bringing you the latest updates from the Apple Certified Refurbished store. This week's highlights include MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to purchase products through Apple's official website, with savings of up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality-assured products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for additional purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every new addition and removal from the Apple Certified Refurbished store, saving you the hassle of searching on your own. Inventory changes rapidly, and the purpose of this article is to provide you with information on currently available products, so you can snag your desired items before they sell out.

Mac computers

The prices of MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top recommended deals. Both are perfect for users new to the Apple ecosystem, or those upgrading to a product equipped with Apple Silicon chips.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (original price $699)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (original price $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (original price $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (original price $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (original price $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (original price $1,699)

Studio Display

We previously mentioned that the Studio Display XDR has appeared in the Apple Refurbished Store. As we often remind everyone, inventory changes can happen quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (original price $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (original price $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited entry-level Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with a higher-end version equipped with an Ethernet port. The entry-level version typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, seize the opportunity.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 64GB storage, Wi-Fi): $169 (original price $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet): $209 (original price $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want to do the same, here are this week's featured deals from the Apple Refurbished Store:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black ocean band: $679 (original price $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue ocean band: $679 (original price $799)

As always, you can stay up to date on all the latest Apple deals this week at 9to5Tools.
